name: Stiff Anvilback
description: Lift the hammer overhead in both hands and drop the flat face straight down onto the target.

name: Smithstrike
description: Drive the haft upward from low guard so the hammer head rises into the opponent's chin or elbow.

name: Forgebump
description: Swing the hammer level from the hip so the face knocks the target's weapon arm aside.

name: Resting Spikeback
description: Hold the haft across the body with both hands to stop a downward cut before it lands.

name: Shifting Peenside
description: Slide the lead foot forward and bring the rear foot up to close distance with the head held high.

name: Sharp Clawside
description: Swing the hammer in a flat arc at head height so the face cracks across the target's helm.

name: Forgehit
description: Drop the hammer low on a slant to strike the front of the opponent's knee.

name: Anvilbump
description: Turn the hammer so the blunt back raps up under a raised arm and into the ribs.

name: Cheekplate Lid
description: Meet an incoming blade with the rim of the hammer head and turn it off the line of the body.

name: Peenlid
description: Plant both feet and brace the haft against both hands to stop a heavy blow without giving ground.

name: Anvilfall Trot
description: Pivot on the rear heel to bring the hammer back to guard after a swing has missed.

name: Single Drivehome
description: Bring the hammer face down on the crown of a helm to dent the metal and stun the wearer.

name: Upward Forge
description: Swing the head in a short arc into the shoulder plate so the hit numbs the arm beneath.

name: Sudden Tamp
description: Drive the flat face into the chest plate so the shock carries through the wearer's ribs.

name: Peenpause
description: Hook the rear of the head behind a collar plate and pull to break the target's stance.

name: Straight Hammerface
description: Thrust the front spike of the head at the narrow slit of a visor to force the opponent back.

name: Eyehole Lid
description: Set the spike in a seam of the armor and lever hard to loosen a strap and spoil the guard.

name: Shifting Hammerneck
description: Step back with the haft braced across the chest so a charging foe meets wood and steel.

name: Tampdrop
description: Snap the wrist so the short hammer head taps sharply onto the back of a gripping hand.

name: Wide Hammerblow
description: Hinge from the elbow to bring the hammer face quickly into the opponent's ribs at close range.

name: Tripping Cheekplate
description: Punch the edge of the small shield into the target's weapon arm while the hammer waits above.

name: Raised Faceplate
description: Turn the hammer rim so a thrust slides past the hip and the hammer is ready to answer.

name: Keen Eyehole
description: Raise the buckler to cover the face while the hammer cracks sideways at the unguarded knee.

name: Anviltrot
description: Take a short step back with the buckler forward and the hammer cocked beside the ear.

name: Blunt Forge
description: Rise in the stirrups and bring the hammer down onto a foot soldier passing at the horse's shoulder.

name: Peenstrike
description: Swing back along the flank as the horse passes so the blunt back of the head cracks a helm.

name: Sudden Peenbite
description: Brace both feet in the stirrups so the hammer swings with the weight of the whole body behind it.

name: Planted Beakpick
description: Hold the rein hand low and the hammer across the saddle front to stop a spear thrust.

name: Anvilpace
description: Turn the mount in a tight curve to leave a clash with the hammer held up and ready.

name: Wide Drivehome
description: Slide the hands apart on the long haft and swing the head over the shoulder in one huge arc.

name: Smithbump
description: Drive the capped butt of the haft straight into the opponent's belly to open space.

name: Low Hammerblow
description: Slide the rear hand to the end of the haft to reach a foe just beyond normal hammer range.

name: Spikeback Pause
description: Catch the beak behind a knee or a shield rim and drag it to unbalance the target.

name: Beakpick Cowl
description: Hold the haft in both hands at the middle and take a cut on the wood between the grips.

name: Smithpause
description: Spin the haft in front of the body so the head and butt sweep thrusts aside.

name: Smithhop
description: Take a long step through the swing so the weight of the stride follows the hammer to its mark.

name: Forgepause
description: Drop the head onto an enemy blade lying on the ground to pin it beneath the face.

name: Level Hammerface
description: Send a thin thread of qi into the head as it falls so the face lands harder than muscle alone allows.

name: Open Peenside
description: Time one full breath with the swing so qi and body weight reach the head together.

name: Snug Faceplate
description: Stiffen the haft with a light pulse of qi so a blow is thrown off and the hammer springs back.

name: Upward Clawside
description: Tighten the grip on the haft and loosen it at impact so qi runs cleanly into the head.

name: Angled Anvilback
description: Stamp the front foot and settle qi into the legs to take a blow without moving.

name: Easing Tamp
description: Pulse qi into the legs for one quick step that carries the cocked hammer to the target's side.

name: Anvilhit
description: Drive the hips over the front heel so the full body weight rides into the hammer face.

name: Sharp Anvilfall
description: Load weight on the back foot then shift forward through a wide arc to land a crushing blow.

name: Hammerface Hit
description: Use the rear poll as a counterweight to whip the head around into a tight second blow.

name: Ready Hammerneck
description: Settle weight low behind the haft held across the body so the stance takes the force of a strike.

name: Hooding Faceplate
description: Shift weight off the line of a blow and tap the hammer face against the weapon to turn it.

name: Anvilamble
description: Take two quick shifting steps so the hammer lands on the second while the foe still answers the first.

name: Smooth Eyehole
description: Pause in a low stance and feel the weight on the opponent's feet to read the next move.

name: Gnawing Peenbite
description: Press the flat face of the head against the target in a hard shove to break their footing.

name: Short Anvilfall
description: Tap the sharp beak against a visor or an armor gap to test a guard before the full blow.

name: Brisk Spikeback
description: Twist the haft in the hands to turn from face to beak between one blow and the next.

name: Hammerneck Pause
description: Catch an incoming blade between beak and haft and turn it down and away from the body.

name: Nimble Anvilback
description: Step inside the foe's reach in one pace with the beak forward to threaten the face.

name: Resting Cheekplate
description: Raise the haft above the head in both hands to stop a cut aimed at the skull.

name: Lowered Clawside
description: Drop the hammer head low beside the leg so the haft covers the thigh against a low cut.

name: Lowered Spikeback
description: Cross the rim of the head over an attacking blade and turn it wide with a wrist twist.

name: Resting Beakpick
description: Circle the haft once to carry a thrust round the body and past the hip.

name: Forgeblow
description: Answer a held guard at once with a short rising blow of the face under the attacker's guard.

name: Hammerblow Strike
description: Spin after a parry to drive the blunt poll into the attacker's weapon hand.

name: Forgecowl
description: Hook the beak over the attacker's wrist as the blow ends and pull the arm across the body.

name: Tamptrot
description: Step back out of reach after a counter and settle the hammer into guard again.

name: Flat Peenside
description: Land the full face of the head with a short stiff arm so the shock sinks into the target.

name: Anvildash
description: Pulse qi into the haft at the moment of contact so the blow jolts the flesh behind a plate.

name: Forward Drivehome
description: Close until the head is a hand's width from the target and snap the hammer in with the forearm.

name: Tampbump
description: Follow a first blow at once with a second light tap on the same spot of the armor.

name: Raised Clawside
description: Let the rim of the head take an incoming blow and spring away with a short pulse of qi.

name: Kept Faceplate
description: Stamp the rear foot to set the stance firmly before the hammer meets a charging foe.

name: Skipping Drivehome
description: Step in a short triangle around the foe's front foot to bring the hammer to their flank.

name: Nimble Peenbite
description: Slide sideways past a charge with the haft angled so the head clips the shoulder in passing.

name: Anvilblow
description: Pace in a quarter circle and drive the hammer in as the front foot lands.

name: Stepping Forge
description: Spring off the back heel with a pulse of qi to leap clear of a low sweep.

name: Stiff Hammerblow
description: Cross the rear foot in front as the hammer swings so the body turns into the blow.

name: Low Anvilback
description: Pivot on the front foot and drop the poll onto the target's back foot as it steps.

name: Turning Beakpick
description: Hook the beak behind the heel of the opponent's lead foot and sweep it out from under them.

name: Anvillid
description: Plant a wide pace and bring the haft across the body to turn a charge into a standstill.
